transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Hi, doctor. Well, I'm here because... I've been having some trouble with my eating. What happens is, once I start picking at the leftovers late at night, it feels like the sensible part of me is saying, 'That’s enough, Alejandro,' but... my hand just keeps going back for more anyway. I just can't seem to stop myself once I start.
When this happens, do you end up eating an unusually large amount of food?

Yeah, I do. Some nights after supper, when I’m supposed to be putting away the tamales or the mole, I’ll end up eating several servings of it right there. And then I'll usually have some pan dulce out in the garage, too. It's... well, it's definitely a lot more food than I’d ever actually put on a plate if my family was around watching me.
During these eating episodes, do you feel unable to stop or control how much you’re eating?

Yes, exactly. Like I was saying when we first sat down, I just can't seem to stop myself. It's like... my brain knows I should quit, and I tell myself 'that's enough,' but my hands just keep moving and grabbing more food anyway. I really do feel completely unable to control it once I start.
Do these eating episodes upset you a lot?

I don't know if I'd say they upset me a lot. I mean, it definitely bothers me... I feel pretty foolish afterward when I realize how much I actually ate. But it's not like I'm crying over it or anything like that. It's really just frustrating, I guess.
When these episodes happen, are you usually not physically hungry when you start eating?

Yeah, that's right. A lot of the time I'm not even hungry. I mean, I usually just had a good, full dinner with everyone else. But then later on, I still find myself opening up the containers and just tasting one thing after another. It's not about being hungry at all.
After you eat like that, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I've never done anything like that. I mean, I just kind of sit there feeling overly full afterward... but no, I don't ever make myself throw up.
How often do these eating episodes happen?
Well, looking back on it... these late-night leftover episodes have been happening at least once most weeks. Often two nights, actually. It's been going on like this ever since my cousin moved in.
When these eating episodes happen, do you usually eat alone because you feel embarrassed about how much you're eating?

Yeah, I do. I make sure I wait until the house is totally quiet, or sometimes I'll even take things out to the garage. I'd just be really embarrassed for my cousin or my family to see how much I'm eating. I mean, at my age, I'm supposed to be the disciplined one in the house. So, yeah, I definitely make sure I'm alone when I do it.
For how many months has this been happening?
I'd say it's been about four months. Like I mentioned, that's when my older cousin came to live with us, so... yeah, right around four months now.
